name: Avalanche
body:
School conjuration (creation) [cold]; Level druid 9, shaman 9, sorcerer/wizard 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area one 10-ft. square/level
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You conjure an overwhelming avalanche of ice and snow and the squares of snow must be contiguous. All creatures in an area covered by the avalanche taking 10d6 bludgeoning damage and 10d6 cold damage. The targets must make a Reflex save or be carried along, downhill or in a direction of the caster’s choice on a flat surface, by 5 feet per caster level and be knocked prone.

The targets move until an obstacle prevents the movement. The avalanche also extinguishes normal fires. The snow and ice remain in the area until they melt normally.
